title: Text Models
summary: The text_models module provides a comprehensive collection of transformer-based models for various natural language processing tasks, including causal language modeling, sequence classification, question answering, and conditional generation.

nodes.label: Causal Language Models
nodes.title: Causal Language Models
nodes.description: Models designed for generating text by predicting the next token in a sequence, often used for text generation and auto-completion. Many incorporate Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures.

nodes.label: Sequence Classification Models
nodes.title: Sequence Classification Models
nodes.description: Models that classify entire input sequences, suitable for tasks like sentiment analysis, topic classification, or protein function prediction.

nodes.label: Question Answering Models
nodes.title: Question Answering Models
nodes.description: Models specialized in extracting answers from a given text based on a question, predicting start and end positions of the answer span.

nodes.label: Conditional Generation Models
nodes.title: Conditional Generation Models
nodes.description: Models that generate text or other sequences conditioned on an input, used for tasks like summarization, machine translation, and dialogue systems.

nodes.label: Masked Language Models
nodes.title: Masked Language Models
nodes.description: Models that predict masked tokens within a sequence, primarily used for pre-training and understanding contextual relationships in text.

nodes.label: Token Classification Models
nodes.title: Token Classification Models
nodes.description: Models that classify individual tokens within a sequence, useful for tasks such as Named Entity Recognition (NER) or Part-of-Speech (POS) tagging.

nodes.label: Time Series Prediction Models
nodes.title: Time Series Prediction Models
nodes.description: Models adapted for forecasting future values in time-dependent data, often utilizing Transformer architectures with various distribution outputs.

nodes.label: Multimodal Models
nodes.title: Multimodal Models
nodes.description: Models capable of processing and generating across multiple modalities, such as text and audio, integrating different generation components.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Model Architectures
nodes.description: Core architectural components and base models that serve as foundations for various task-specific models.

nodes.label: Data Processing
nodes.title: Data Processing
nodes.description: Utilities and components for preparing and transforming data for model input, including tokenizers and feature extractors.

groups.label: Text Generation
groups.title: Text Generation Models
groups.description: Models primarily focused on generating coherent and contextually relevant text, including causal language models and conditional generation models.

groups.label: Text Understanding
groups.title: Text Understanding Models
groups.description: Models designed for analyzing and interpreting text, encompassing tasks like classification, question answering, and token-level analysis.

groups.label: Specialized Models
groups.title: Specialized Models
groups.description: Models tailored for specific domains or advanced functionalities beyond general text processing, such as time series or multimodal tasks.

groups.label: Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Core components and utilities from other modules that this module relies on for its functionality.
